name: Ref Rework
teaser: Sell dogtags to Ref for GP coins!
description:
NOTE: The vast majority of this mod is from Geko’s Better Progression (sp-mod.com/mod/2088/gekos-better-progression) by DrunkGeko, with permission. Go check out their mod, this is just a small part of it ripped out and ported to SPT 4.1.x

This mod lets you sell dogtags to Ref, in exchange for GP. Higher level dogtags are worth more GP.

Config includes:

-Fine tune how much dogtags are worth in GP, with default values, they increase in value by 1 GP for every 7 levels, capping at 10 GP

-Blocks dogtag sales to other traders, can turn off

-Lega Medal barter at Ref 1, costs 100 GP, adjustable

-Lega Medals can no longer be sold, only used in barters
